blocks.text: Bill Hader was once just a tired father sitting in the warm glow of a bedside lamp. Every night, he turned the pages of Dr. Seuss books for his three young daughters. Those quiet nightly routine did more than just put his kids to sleep. They built gentle threads connecting his childhood memories to his children’s lives. When Warner Bros. Pictures Animation asked him to voice the iconic feline in The Cat in the Hat, Hader skipped calling his agent. Instead, he went straight to his youngest daughter.
